cards.headline: Happy songs, no singers
cards.snippet: Track three on Happy Songs for Happy People, recorded at CaVa Studios in Glasgow with producer Tony Doogan and released in June 2003. It is the album where Mogwai leaned away from guitar squall toward synths, piano and strings - and nobody really sings: Stuart Braithwaite does not sing on the record at all, and the few vocals that appear are gibberish. An instrumental built from a handful of notes, named like a warning.
cards.context: The album reached No. 47 in the UK and later went gold in Europe; this track became its longest-lived song.

cards.headline: The bus ride at the end of the world
cards.snippet: In May 2015 the song closed 'Chaos Theory', the third episode of the adventure game Life Is Strange: Max rides the bus back to her friend Chloe's house as the track plays, arriving at a door that opens onto a rewritten life. The placement made the song the game's emotional signature - it sits on the official soundtrack album, and the two biggest uploads of the song on YouTube are both filed under the game's name, a decade of players arriving through the same scene.
cards.context: For a generation of listeners this is not a Mogwai song that was used in a game; it is the sound of that episode ending.

cards.headline: A quieter room in a loud house
cards.snippet: This song is so good because it overlays my parents voices arguing so I'm able to put my self somewhere peaceful in my mind.
cards.context: Posted under the band's official upload: the song as a quieter room inside a loud house.

cards.headline: Four notes are enough
cards.snippet:
A E D, A E C#

Turns out you don't need anymore notes for a peaceful song.
cards.context: A listener counts off the song's whole harmonic world in four notes - and finds that is enough.

life is truly strange

cards.headline: How quickly time flies
cards.snippet: This song makes me realize how quickly time flies, but I still often think about unimportant things and go through my days without big meaning. I'm now in grade 3 of high school, but I'm still filled with doubts about my future.
cards.context: A high-school listener hears his own uncertainty in the song's slow build.

replies.author: @GoldenBJean1983
replies.text: Trust me, I know how you feel, buddy. I’m 21 and I still don’t have it all figured out, feeling lost a lot of the time, but what I can tell you is this; go out, try new things, meet new people, make great memories. Live life now instead of thinking you need to wait for a passion or purpose to be alive. You’ll find it so long as you put yourself out there. I know some days are hard, but what’s lost can be found. We’re in this ocean of uncertainty and chaos together. You’re not alone.

replies.author: @Δ-Δ-Δ-Δ
replies.text:
You remind me of myself.

Don't worry, for me... everything sorted itself out pretty much fine.

Just don't overthink.

Live in the moment.

cards.headline: Live at Stubb's, SXSW 2006
cards.snippet: A fan-shot recording from Stubb's in Austin on March 15, 2006, with Mogwai playing SXSW three years after the album - one of the oldest live clips of the song on YouTube, watched more than 32,000 times. One listener: "this is one of two songs in the world that can bring a tear to my eye."

cards.headline: Live in Philadelphia, 2008
cards.snippet: Filmed from the crowd at the Starlight Ballroom in Philadelphia on September 19, 2008, and watched more than 8,800 times. One listener: "Gotta love the bass in this song, this and mogwai fear satan are few of the best songs I've ever heard"

cards.headline: Three visits to the care home
cards.snippet: Ricky Gervais's grief comedy keeps coming back to this song: it plays three times across the first season of After Life (2019), each time around Tony's visits to his father in the care home - arriving to see him, talking to the nurse, looking at the building from outside. A show about a man learning to live after loss scores its tenderest storyline with a wordless Mogwai track.
cards.context: All three placements sit in the care-home storyline, the show's emotional core.
